paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan: Avot, chapter 4. I shall write for you who was teacher, student, or colleague of the unqualified Rabbi Yonatan. Rabbi Abba bar Chiyya bar Abba transmitted in his name. Rabbi Abbahu transmitted in his name: Kohelet Rabbah, on ‘He made everything beautiful in its time.’ Avin transmitted in his name. Rabbi Acha bar Chiyya transmitted in his name: Vayikra Rabbah, section 35. Rabbi Ilai. Rabbi Binyamin bar Yefet transmitted in his name: Bereshit Rabbah, section 43. Rabbi Berekhiah transmitted in his name. Rav Dimi said in Rabbi Yonatan’s name: Bekhorot 51b, Bava Batra 74b and 79a. Rabbi Zeira transmitted in his name. Rabbi Chavivi; Rabbi Chiyya. Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba said in Rabbi Yonatan’s name. Rav Chana bar Abba; Rav Chanana. Rabbi Chisda said in Rabbi Yonatan’s name: Bava Kamma 67a. Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi; Rabbi Yochanan transmitted in his name: Rabbah, Acharei Mot, end of section 22. In Rabbi Yonatan of Beit Guvrin’s name. Rabbi Yose; Rabbi Yannai. Rabbi Yaakov bar Yochai transmitted in his name, as did Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha. Rabbi Yishmael. Rabbi Menachem transmitted in his name. He asked Rabbi Menachem Talmaya. He asked Rabbi Natan Deroma. He said in Rabbi’s name: Zevachim 99b, in the new Talmud edition as an alternative reading. Ravin transmitted in his name. Bar Kappara; Rabbah bar bar Chana. Rabbi Shmuel bar Ammi said in Rabbi Yonatan’s name. Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani was his student. Rabbi Simlai questioned him. He raised a difficulty to Rabbi Shimon ben Yakum. In Rabbi Shimon ben Yose ben Lakonya’s name. Ben Azzai. Shimon bar Abba transmitted in his name: Midrash Megillah.
